summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that the last deposit of stakes for the Tom Allen and Charley Gallagher fight was made at Allen's saloon, and tickets were out for a steamboat excursion to the battleground on August 17, 1869.

metadata.notes: masthead reads THE MISSOURI REPUBLICAN--ST. LOUIS, AUGUST 15, 1869

facts.fact: The final stakes for the Allen-Gallagher fight were deposited at Allen's saloon; the fight was set for August 17, 1869, with spectators taken to the battleground by steamboat from St. Louis
